title: CIP Security: Support UDP-only EtherNet/IP transport profile
description:
This mode reuses an existing UDP stream, and has a special command (StartDTLS).
This works like STARTTLS for other protocols.

1. Flag a given stream as DTLS, after we receive the StartDTLS response.
2. Always process the ENIP command, even if the length is zero. This supports item 1, but also will catch malformed packets, which have incorrect sizes.
3. Add an explicit 'Decode As' for DTLS -> ENIP
